steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: The Campfire
steps.body:
Welcome to camp. This is your breather between dungeon rooms. You can see your party's condition and any loot you've collected so far.

From here, you choose which room to tackle next. No turning back — the only way out is forward, to extraction at the end of the floor.

steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: Choose Your Path
steps.body:
You'll see two options for the next room. Choice A is always a standard combat encounter. Choice B might be a story event with interesting rewards — or an elite fight that's tougher but drops better loot.

Weigh the risk against your party's health before choosing.
